title: Instagram and Medium Fetchers
description: Begins with an everyday explanation, then traces RedditFetcher in src/fetchers/reddit_fetcher.py. Source units combined: Reddit Fetcher and Tiktok Fetcher, Twitter Fetcher and Youtube Fetcher.

learning_objectives.text: Explain instagram and medium fetchers in plain language using the project source.
Trace `RedditFetcher` in `src/fetchers/reddit_fetcher.py` and explain its inputs, behavior, and output.
Use a test or boundary case to assess what the implementation proves and what remains unverified.

source_code_focus.source_status: source tree absent; excerpt retained from earlier package

practical_outcomes: Explain one data or control boundary.
completion_criteria: Complete all three lessons and the source exercise.
Answer ten module questions using lesson evidence.
Distinguish actual code behavior from assumptions and proposed extensions.
